name: What types of banquette seating designs are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of banquette seating designs are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Banquette seating can be customized into various designs to fit a space's function and aesthetic. Common types include straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, and circular configurations. These designs can incorporate built-in storage, backrests, or be free-standing. When considering a design, think about the primary use of the banquette and how it will integrate with your existing furniture and room layout, as this will influence both comfort and accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Banquette seating comes in straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, and circular designs, often with built-in storage or backrests.
